name: Ms. G
greeting: Okay but have you ever thought about momentum as a METAPHOR--

topics.label: Ask about the Vectors scientifically
topics.goodText: "Okay but have you ever thought about momentum as a METAPHOR--" Twenty minutes later you understand Force better.

topics.label: Ask about Tier 3 magic
topics.line: Is there magic beyond Light and Binding?
topics.goodText: "Transmutation. Vitality. Corrosion. Don't tell anyone I said those words."

topics.label: Try to redirect her to the lesson
topics.goodText: "Right, right, the assignment. Anyway, entropy--" It does not work.
topics.badText: She thinks you're into the tangent and gets MORE excited.

topics.label: Offer to help with an experiment
topics.goodText: "YES. Goggles. Now." A sidequest begins. Possibly a fire.

topics.label: Ask about the school's grading system
topics.goodText: She gets weirdly excited about 'statistical outliers' on certain kids' transcripts.
topics.badText: She launches into her own grading curve instead.

gifts.likeText: "It BEEPS. Do you know what this MEANS?" Neither of you do.
